title: The workspace adapts without losing access
description:
As a member using different screens or assistive input, I want the workspace to remain navigable.

Feature: Responsive and accessible workspace

Scenario: Use a narrow screen
Given the workspace is narrower than the desktop layout
When the member opens the roster or inspector
Then each opens as an accessible sheet
And the conversation and composer remain usable

Scenario: Use the keyboard
Given the member navigates without a pointer
When focus moves through roster, composer, and inspector controls
Then focus is visible
And every icon-only control has an accessible name

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented locally: desktop three-pane layout, tablet/mobile roster and inspector sheets, independently scrolling panes, anchored composer, accessible labels, focus-visible treatment, light/dark tokens, and reduced-motion handling. Visual QA and deployed verification remain.

comments.author: ryan
